data.one_liner: Extracts open source license information from Dart packages using pubspec.yaml
data.what_it_does: Reads the project's pubspec.lock to gather and assemble open source software license details. Generates a Dart file or a JSON file containing all package metadata and licenses.
use_when: You need to display an open source licenses page in your mobile, desktop, or web application
You want to automate license information collection during your build or release process
avoid_when: You need runtime dynamic extraction of licenses without pre-generating a file
strengths: Supports generating either a Dart constant file or a JSON file
Handles complex workspaces and package directories
weaknesses: Requires pub get / pub upgrade to be run before generating licenses
Does nothing at runtime as it is purely a build-time tool
data.setup_notes: Add the package to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml and run dart run dart_pubspec_licenses:generate
data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
  dart_pubspec_licenses: ^3.2.0

# Run command:
dart run dart_pubspec_licenses:generate
